newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico arrests fugitive Argentine entrepreneur.
newsitem.headline: Mexico arrests fugitive Argentine entrepreneur.

text.p: Mexico arrested one of Argentina's most wanted fugitives, entrepreneur Luis Angel Hector Legnani, accused of defrauding a bank of $14 million, authorities said on on Wednesday.
They said he was being held pending extradition.

After tracking the fugitive across five countries, police working in conjunction with Interpol caught Legnani at Mexico's Benito Juarez airport on Tuesday as he arrived from the Mexican coastal resort of Acapulco.
"Luis Hector Legnani was transferred to the Reclusorio Norte prison in the capital city, where he is awaiting extradition," Mexico's Attorney General's Office said.
Argentina requested Legnani's arrest and extradition in April. The fraud was allegedly committed at Argentina's Banco Social de Cordoba.
